title: Punch List Cadence
short_answer: How we walk punch with a GC or owner: drywall first, paint second, photos always, and a clear line between our punch and other-trade damage.
summary: How we walk punch with a GC or owner: drywall first, paint second, photos always, and a clear line between our punch and other-trade damage.
plain_words: Punch is a process, not a mood. Prep the room, walk with light, fix the wall before you touch paint, and write everything down. Verbal-only punch on commercial work is how items come back a month later as "you never fixed that."
when_to_use: GC or owner punch walk on commercial or warranty work
Before closing Job Check Completion or calling the job done
After major trades finish and before final paint touch-up
prerequisites: QC walk habit — raking light and honest marking
Drywall Touch-Up and Paint Touch-Up procedures understood

tools.name: Low-tack tape or pencil for marking

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Clean enough to see, tools ready, raking light in hand (see QC Walk + Drywall Touch-Up).

steps.title: Drywall punch first
steps.body: Defects, ridges, voids, screw issues. Mark outside the defect.

steps.title: Prime repairs
steps.body: Prime repairs, then Paint Touch-Up on a ready wall — not paint over dust.

steps.title: Photo + written list
steps.body: Photo and written list the same day. Commercial: never leave it verbal-only.

steps.title: Other-trade damage
steps.body: Photo before you touch it; then CO / T&M path if we are asked to repair (Spotting a Change Order).

steps.title: Close honestly
steps.body: Close Job Check / Completion only when the list is truly closed — not when everyone is tired of looking at it.

warnings.title: Verbal-only punch on commercial work
warnings.body: Items come back a month later as "you never fixed that." Photo + written list the same day — every walk.

warnings.title: Paint before drywall is ready
warnings.body: Paint over dust or unprimed compound buys a second mobilization. Drywall punch first, prime, then touch-up paint.

quality_checks.prompt: Room prepped and raking light used for the walk
Drywall defects fixed and primed before paint touch-up
Photo + written punch list completed same day (commercial mandatory)
Completion / Job Check closed only when the list is actually closed

common_mistakes.title: Verbal-only commercial punch
common_mistakes.wrong: Walk with the GC and fix items with no written record
common_mistakes.right: Photo + written list the same day
common_mistakes.why: Comes back as disputed work weeks later

common_mistakes.title: Paint over dust
common_mistakes.wrong: Touch up paint before drywall repairs are primed
common_mistakes.why: Flashing and adhesion failures — paid twice

common_mistakes.title: Closing when tired
common_mistakes.wrong: Mark Completion because everyone wants to leave
common_mistakes.right: Close only when the punch list is truly closed
common_mistakes.why: Job Check Completion is a promise to the office and GC

common_mistakes.title: Repairing other-trade damage for free
common_mistakes.wrong: Fix electrician damage without a photo or CO path
common_mistakes.right: Photo first; CO / T&M if asked to repair
common_mistakes.why: Our punch is not their damage
